name: US Dollar Payment Token
oneLiner: USDPT is Western Union's Solana dollar stablecoin issued by Anchorage Digital Bank with U.S. Bank as reserve custodian for B2B agent settlement.
collateral: U.S. dollar reserves held for USDPT, including bank deposits, U.S. Treasury bills, and similar cash equivalents
pegMechanism: Issuer-managed 1:1 redemption for U.S. dollars; Anchorage Digital Bank N.A. issues USDPT, with each token matched by an equal amount of U.S. dollar reserves

applicabilityBasis.summary: USDPT is a U.S. dollar stablecoin issued by Anchorage Digital Bank for Western Union's global payment and settlement network.

genius.notes: Western Union identifies Anchorage Digital Bank as issuer and describes 1:1 reserves, but Pharos found no token-specific public OCC GENIUS approval or PPSI registration.

references.label: OCC: Anchorage national trust bank charter

sourcesChecked: OCC GENIUS Act rulemaking bulletin and public releases
OCC Anchorage Digital Bank charter materials
Western Union USDPT product and launch disclosures
negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No token-specific public OCC GENIUS approval, PPSI registration, state-qualified approval, or official application source was located for USDPT.

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: USDPT resolves to Yes because existing metadata classifies the asset as centralized and no manual override narrows that status.

launchPhaseDetail: LAUNCHED May 4, 2026 on Solana for B2B settlement; Philippines and Bolivia as first markets; Fireblocks selected as core settlement infrastructure; 'Stable by Western Union' consumer product planned for 40+ markets later in 2026; DAN live with first partner Apr 28, seven more activations expected by end of 2026; Anchorage Digital Bank issuer, U.S. Bank reserve custodian. As of late May 2026 DefiLlama tracks USDPT with ~$1.5M circulating against a verified Solana mint (HVWf8JmLoHs99Lw8Psf3fyqAtA4crWxCPkrmSdNjhNH3); the CoinGecko entry (usdpt-western-union) remains preview-only with no price feed, so promotion to active is pending confirmation of a fetchable runtime price path

featuredContent.title: USDPT and the Digital Asset Network, built on Solana
Western Union to Launch Stablecoin on Solana With Anchorage Digital
featuredContent.description: Western Union plans to launch USDPT for its 100-million-user payment network, becoming the latest traditional finance firm tapping blockchain rails for global transfers.

featuredContent.title: Western Union has big plans for stablecoins
featuredContent.description: CEO Devin McGranahan outlines strategy: converting negative float to positive float revenue, opening network to community banks, and enabling dollar-denominated holdings in inflationary regions.

featuredContent.title: Western Union's Solana-Based Stablecoin Could Reshape Its Payment Model
featuredContent.description: Analyst coverage of the May 4 USDPT launch: B2B agent settlement first, consumer-facing 'Stable by Western Union' product planned for 40+ markets later in 2026.

milestones.title: Western Union announces USDPT on Solana with Anchorage Digital
milestones.description: USDPT to be issued by Anchorage Digital Bank, connecting on-chain dollar transfers to Western Union's cash network spanning 200+ countries.

milestones.title: Anchorage Digital Bank named as federally regulated issuer
Crossmint partnership for wallet infrastructure and payment APIs
milestones.description: Crossmint integrates USDPT into wallet infrastructure, enabling fintech developers to build on Solana with cash-out through Western Union locations.

milestones.title: CEO speaks at Digital Asset Summit NYC; U.S. Bank confirmed as reserve custodian
milestones.description: McGranahan outlines float-revenue model, community bank onboarding vision, and dollar-denominated holdings for inflationary regions; confirms U.S. Bank as custodian via Anchorage Digital.

milestones.title: CEO confirms May 2026 USDPT launch on Q1 earnings call
milestones.description: McGranahan tells analysts USDPT is in final stages and launching in May as an alternative to SWIFT interbank settlement, not initially consumer-facing; consumer-facing USD Stable Card planned for later in 2026.

milestones.title: Digital Asset Network (DAN) goes live with first partner
milestones.description: First DAN partner activates the week of Apr 27, giving crypto wallets access to Western Union's 360,000+ payout locations across 200+ countries via single API; seven additional DAN partners expected before end of 2026.

milestones.title: USDPT launches on Solana; Philippines and Bolivia as first markets
milestones.description: Western Union officially rolls out USDPT on the Solana blockchain for B2B agent settlement, with 'Stable by Western Union' consumer product planned for 40+ markets later in 2026.

milestones.title: Fireblocks selected as core settlement infrastructure partner
milestones.description: Fireblocks (including Dynamic embedded wallets and TRES financial platform) powers USDPT's custody, settlement, and wallet infrastructure.
